caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a wooden floor covered with an elaborate network of colorful rectangular blocks arranged in chains, several of which rest on small white-and-brown elevated stands while others stand directly on the planks. A domino cascade is already underway, propagating through the chains one after another rather than all at once. The curved loop at the lower right flattens as its magenta and orange end blocks topple to lie flat. The orange and yellow blocks at the right end of the top-middle chain fall over, and a toppling wave then runs through the upper-left diagonal pink-and-red chain, leaving it flattened. The magenta block at the right end of the bottom-left elevated chain tips down. A block near the left end of the top-left cluster tilts shortly before the right-middle chain's orange block falls. Throughout, the far-right zigzag chain, the leftmost floor chain, the central vertical blue chain, and all the stands themselves remain upright and in place.
